caption:
WADA's 2026 list has a category most people miss 🔬 Most peptides fall under S2, peptide hormones and growth factors. BPC-157 doesn't — it sits in S0, the class for substances no health authority anywhere has approved for human use.

Which class is yours in? All 123 are listed at pepsafe.info
